[Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea)

## Overview

## Appearance

Annetta Bell is a pale, small individual. She features smooth ripples of fine, silky, fawn-colored hair that flows over her shoulders.

## History

Annetta Bell became a student at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school after her parents moved their house slightly north, placing them within the district. As part of a class assignment, she wrote a composition letter to her teacher, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), which she amusingly copied from old love letters. She continued her education in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) alongside her peers, experiencing events such as a terrible storm that later swept through the village and caused widespread damage.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P2](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0002), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P22](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0022), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P23](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0023), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), +79 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--annetta-bell.md)

Annetta Bell is one of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's students at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. Their dynamic is illustrated through Annetta's schoolwork, such as when she writes a compositions letter copied from old love letters, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds amusing enough to recount to a friend. Though affected by Anne's eventual resignation as teacher, Annetta remains one of the pupils under her care throughout Anne's teaching tenure.

- Student of — pupil affected by teacher's resignation  <sub>[v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)</sub>
